launches.title: Madrone - chiller-less cooling for desert data centers
launches.tagline: Madrone builds efficient cooling without installing a chiller, saving tens of millions of dollars per facility.
launches.body:
Hey everyone!

We’re [Akshay](https://www.linkedin.com/in/akshay-trikha/) and [Erik](https://www.linkedin.com/in/erikmeike/), the founders of [Madrone](https://madrone.cool).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101247&key=user_uploads/2118032/aef61dad-d700-4244-bc3a-096c61aaba81)

**TLDR;** Giant data centers are being built in the desert and need better cooling. Madrone builds modular cooling systems that chill water to the dew point, slashing power usage and deploying fast.

**Problems**

* Data centers are limited by power availability, not chips or land
* Up to 30% of facility power is diverted to cooling instead of GPUs
* Data centers are being built in the desert, where cooling is hard
* Grid permits are backlogged for years (efficient cooling unlocks more compute)

**Our Solution**

We’re building a facility water cooling system that cools to the dew point (lower than competitors) while using less power and water. Our system is modular and designed to be fabricated and installed as quickly as possible to accelerate our customers' time to deployment.

Every 1% of cooling efficiency = $2.6 million more GPU revenue / 100 MW / year. That means Madrone’s cooling efficiency saves $78 million / 100 MW / year.

Here’s our 1kW prototype:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101247&key=user_uploads/2118032/bd66a088-4246-438d-ac59-570015655e80)

Here’s us building our 100kW prototype:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101247&key=user_uploads/2118032/9d94b343-6f27-4b97-ab66-bd5345fb2581)

**We’re full stack**

We design everything from the electronics, to the heat exchangers, to the software in-house to squeeze every watt of performance. Erik spent 4 years at Apple designing power & thermal systems for the iPhone. Akshay built ML systems running 1M+ inferences/month at QuantumScape.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101247&key=user_uploads/2118032/39751a33-4b7a-4726-9c37-00d2f6d2b410)

**Ask:** If you're building data centers, we'd love to work with you.
